title: Juicy Silky Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A weeknight Argentinian dish featuring redcurrants and a robata grill, this recipe is macrobiotic friendly and full of umami flavor. The silky texture of the beef is achieved with a special marinade.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Let the beef marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the beef is cooking, brush the redcurrants with a little olive oil and season with salt.
Grill the redcurrants for 2-3 minutes, until they start to burst.
Serve the beef skewers with the grilled redcurrants and your choice of sides.
